reviews.text:
White Noise changed my life. This app is a blessing. I never write reviews, and I know nobody will read this, but it’s 1am on my 19th birthday and I felt compelled to leave my mark here before I sleep. For over a decade I have fallen asleep to all sorts of sounds when I was little I loved listening to cats purring, rain, and the distant wail of sirens. When I was only a few days old my parents began the habit of leaving classical music on a little pink stereo while I slept. 
Somewhere down the line my mom began listening to the “Airplane Travel” sound this app offers. As of writing this, we have a combined listening time of almost 4 years. 

As of writing this I have drifted away from my mother, and throughout my short life I’ve certainly found myself sinking incredibly far down into dangerous places. However, no matter where I have gone and will go, this sound grounds me. 

I wish I could personally thank whoever created this, the sounds loop seamlessly and help me feel safe at night. I wish nothing but the best for anyone reading this, and for the creators of this app.
